headline: COMEX COPPER SMASHES ALL-TIME RECORD AT $6.70/LB AS TARIFF TIMELINE CONFIRMED — PREMIUM TO LME HITS $640/TONNE; BACKWARDATION DEEPENS
snippet: COMEX September copper futures touched a new all-time record of $6.7045 per pound on August 8, 2026 — equivalent to $14,781 per metric tonne — as the White House confirmed a phased tariff structure for copper imports: 15% taking effect in January 2027, rising to 30% in 2028. The announcement crystallised what had previously been trader speculation into a locked-in arbitrage framework: the COMEX-LME premium widened to approximately $640 per tonne, well above July's average of $350, as US buyers pre-loaded ahead of the tariff effective date. On the LME, copper climbed to $14,050 — approaching January's all-time high of $14,500 — while the LME cash-to-three-month spread flipped into the deepest backwardation since January, signalling acute near-term physical tightness. Combined COMEX and LME official inventories have surged more than 40% year-to-date to all-time highs as US buyers convert global supply flows, while Goldman Sachs stated that tariff implementation could push copper above $14,000 per tonne on the LME in H2 2026, triggering a further wave of pre-tariff stockpiling. For junior copper explorers in Canada and the US, the confirmed tariff roadmap is the clearest multi-year signal the sector has received: domestically produced copper and copper from CUSMA-partner jurisdictions avoids the tariff entirely, making North American copper projects structurally more valuable at every stage of development — from exploration-stage in the ground through to permitted and construction-ready.

headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,341 WEEKLY CLOSE AFTER BEST WEEK IN MONTHS — GIVES BACK FRIDAY HIGHS; JULY CPI AUG 12 IS NEXT TEST
snippet: Gold gave back its intraday high of $4,411 reached on Friday August 7 — the highest level in two months — but retained the bulk of its NFP-driven gains to close the week at approximately $4,341 per ounce, GoldSeek reported in its August 8 daily market recap. The weekly gain of approximately 8% is gold's strongest weekly performance in months, driven entirely by the surprise July Non-Farm Payrolls report that showed -23,000 jobs created against a consensus forecast of +80,000 — a miss that collapsed US dollar strength, unwound Federal Reserve rate-hike bets, and sent institutional capital into the safe-haven and inflation-hedge trade simultaneously. Silver, which had moved in sympathy earlier in the week on Strait of Hormuz geopolitical fears, then added a further 4% on the NFP print to close near $64.10 per ounce. The immediate next test for gold is July Consumer Price Index data on August 12, followed by PPI on August 13 and the University of Michigan inflation expectations survey on August 14 — three sequential macro reads that, if they cooperate with the current lower-inflation-expectations narrative, could provide the macro backdrop needed to push gold's weekly close above $4,400 for the first time.

headline: SILVER SURGES 4% TO $64.10 — SIX-WEEK HIGH AS NFP MISS CRUSHES FED RATE HIKE BETS; GOLD HOLDS ABOVE $4,300
snippet: Silver ripped 4.16% higher on Friday August 7 to trade at $64.10 per ounce — a six-week high — after July's US Non-Farm Payrolls report printed -23,000 jobs, far below the +80,000 consensus expectation, according to USAGOLD's daily precious metals market report. The shock NFP miss knocked the US dollar to a two-week low, pushed traders to fully unwind any remaining Federal Reserve rate-hike bets for 2026, and triggered buying across precious metals from institutional and systematic trend-following strategies simultaneously. Gold held firmly above $4,300 throughout the session, reaching an intraday high of $4,411 before settling back to $4,341 — still gold's highest daily close in two months. The broader context: the July jobs report is the second consecutive month of labour market softness, with the prior June reading also below expectations. For silver investors specifically, the metal's 4.16% single-day gain outpaced gold's move, compressing the gold-silver ratio back toward the lower end of its 2026 trading range — a ratio compression that has historically preceded periods where silver outperforms gold on a sustained basis. At $64.10 per ounce, silver remains more than 80% below its 1980 inflation-adjusted all-time high, supporting the long-run bull thesis that the current commodity cycle has meaningful upside remaining.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD STOCKS MARK POWERFUL BREAKOUT — RECORD QUARTERLY EARNINGS IMMINENT; INTERRUPTED UPLEG CONFIRMED GROWING
snippet: GoldSeek published an August 8 analysis confirming that the gold miners' sector has broken out decisively from several months of mid-cycle consolidation, with the VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) and VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ) surging more than 21% and 22% respectively over five trading days — the breakout the analysis identifies as confirming that gold stocks' interrupted cyclical upleg is not only intact but accelerating. The fundamental basis is straightforward: gold at $4,341 per ounce translates into all-in sustaining cost margins for major gold producers that are approximately double or triple any prior cycle, and the sector is about to enter earnings season where those margins will be reported for the first time at this price level. With GDX breaking above multi-month resistance on heavy volume and the NFP catalyst providing the macro justification for the move, technical and fundamental signals are now aligned. The analysis notes that from early October 2023 through late January 2026, gold gained 196.4% in its largest cyclical bull ever in dollar terms, and that gold stocks — which leverage the metal's moves by 2x to 4x depending on cost structure — have not yet fully repriced to reflect that extraordinary underlying price level. For junior mining investors, the message is specific: if the sector's Q2 2026 earnings season confirms record free cash flow at the major producers (a near-certainty given $4,300+ gold against sub-$1,500 AISC structures), the repricing of junior and mid-tier miners with comparable cost profiles has only just started.

headline: COT REPORT AUG 7: SPECS REBUILD GOLD LONGS POST-NFP; SILVER POSITIONING TURNS BULLISH — GOLDSEEK WEEKLY ANALYSIS
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Commitments of Traders analysis for the period ending August 7, 2026 shows large speculative (managed money) positioning in gold futures rebuilding meaningfully following the NFP-driven price breakout — a technical confirmation that institutional trend-following capital has re-entered gold on the long side at current price levels. Silver's COT positioning similarly showed a bullish shift, consistent with the metal's 4%+ single-session gain on Friday. The USDX (US Dollar Index) positioning analysis shows speculative long positioning in the dollar contracting sharply following the NFP miss, removing a significant headwind to gold and silver that had been building through July as Fed rate-hike narratives were priced into the dollar. For gold investors, the COT configuration at this stage of the cycle matters: when large speculators are actively adding new long exposure — rather than buying back short positions — at a price breakout point, it indicates capital flow driven by trend conviction rather than short-covering momentum, which historically produces more sustained directional moves. The current setup, with specs net long gold at elevated but not extreme levels and a fresh macro catalyst having provided the trigger, is broadly constructive for a continued move higher into August earnings season.

headline: GOLD WEEKLY FORECAST: FED RATE HIKE BETS DEAD AFTER NFP MISS — BULLISH PRESSURE BUILDS; AUG 12 CPI IS PIVOTAL
snippet: FXStreet's August 7 weekly gold forecast identifies the -23,000 July NFP print as the macro pivot that may have structurally reset the gold price higher into Q4 2026: the report eliminates the last meaningful scenario in which the Federal Reserve raises interest rates this year, removing the primary macro headwind that had capped gold below $4,250 throughout July. With rate-hike bets unwound, the dollar weakened to a two-week low, and gold's technical picture improved dramatically — the metal is now holding above the critical $4,300 level that had been resistance since June. The week ahead is data-heavy: July Consumer Price Index (CPI) arrives August 12, July Producer Price Index (PPI) on August 13, and the University of Michigan preliminary inflation expectations for August on August 14. If CPI cooperates — printing at or below the 2.8% consensus expectation — the combination of soft employment and contained inflation gives the Fed no justification to tighten policy and gives gold bulls the macro backdrop for the next leg higher toward $4,400 and ultimately $4,500. The risk scenario: a surprise CPI upside print above 3.0% would revive rate-hike speculation and likely trigger a sharp gold pullback from current elevated levels — managing this binary data risk is the key tactical consideration for gold investors in the week ahead.

headline: THOR EXPLORATIONS DRILLS 19.4m AT 3.01 g/t AU BELOW SEGILOLA OPEN PIT — UNDERGROUND STUDY LAUNCHED; RESOURCE UPDATE Q4 2026 (THX)
snippet: Thor Explorations Ltd. (TSX-V: THX, AIM: THX, OTC: THXPF) reported August 6, 2026 that its ongoing diamond drilling programme beneath the current Segilola Gold Mine open pit in Osun State, Nigeria has intersected a steeply dipping high-grade gold shoot in a previously untested area, with mineralisation remaining open at depth across a 400-metre vertical extent below the existing pit shell. Highlight intercepts from the programme include SNMDD089 at 19.4 metres of 3.01 g/t gold from 346 metres depth, SNMDD166 at 5.3 metres of 5.66 g/t gold from 300 metres, and SNMDD179 returning both 2.1 metres at 3.02 g/t from 296.9 metres and 3.3 metres at 5.99 g/t from 307.7 metres — all from the same steeply plunging shoot identified in a previously undrilled structural corridor below the operating pit. Four company-owned rigs are drilling the programme through year-end, and Thor has commissioned an independent mining consultancy to review the underground development potential — with an updated Mineral Resource Estimate targeting inclusion of the new sub-pit zones expected before December 2026. Segilola is currently Nigeria's only operating primary gold mine, which gives the underground extension study geopolitical significance beyond the mine's standalone economics: a confirmed underground resource extension would substantially extend Segilola's mine life and could catalyse the financing and permitting of what would be Nigeria's first underground gold mine. For junior investors tracking African gold projects approaching resource decision points, the 400-metre open-at-depth extent of a continuously mineralised shoot is the key technical signal to monitor in the upcoming Q3 2026 drill results.

headline: LUCA MINING: 184m AT 1.18 g/t AU AND 72 g/t AG IN UNMINED LARGO NORTE ZONE — CAMPO MORADO MINE LIFE EXTENSION TAKING SHAPE (LUCA)
snippet: Luca Mining Corp. (TSXV: LUCA, OTCQX: LUCMF) reported August 6, 2026 underground drill results from its ongoing exploration programme at the producing Campo Morado polymetallic VMS mine in Guerrero State, Mexico, with highlight hole CMUG-26-50 returning 184 metres at 1.18 g/t gold, 72.42 g/t silver, 0.39% copper, 0.45% lead, and 1.67% zinc from just 3.6 metres downhole — including an 18-metre high-grade sub-interval grading 2.64 g/t gold, 152.34 g/t silver, 0.53% copper, 1.05% lead, and 2.52% zinc from 12 metres depth. A second unmined zone, Naranjo, contributed hole CMNJ-26-02 with 9.6 metres at 4.05 g/t gold, 241.09 g/t silver, 0.90% copper, 1.57% lead, and 2.72% zinc from 175.3 metres depth. Both Largo Norte and Naranjo are unmined VMS zones directly adjacent to the existing underground mining infrastructure — meaning any resource defined in these zones is low-capital-cost to mine, accessing ore through headings and development already in place for current production. Campo Morado has operated as a producing mine for years, and each successive drill programme confirming unmined mineralization adjacent to infrastructure adds a near-mine resource increment that translates directly to mine life without requiring new portal development or equipment mobilisation. At $4,300+ gold and silver above $64 per ounce, Luca's combined gold-silver-copper credit makes Campo Morado one of the most metal-price-sensitive near-term production stories in the Mexican VMS belt.

headline: COPPER GIANT RESOURCES: C$31M FINANCING LED BY DENARIUS METALS + TRAFIGURA 10-YEAR OFFTAKE — MOCOA Cu-Mo PROJECT, COLOMBIA (CGNT)
snippet: Copper Giant Resources Corp. (TSXV: CGNT) announced August 6, 2026 a C$31.0 million strategic financing led by Denarius Metals Corp. (TSXV: DMET), in which Denarius will acquire approximately 15.6% of Copper Giant at a C$28.8 million lead investment, with closing expected around August 21, 2026. Concurrent with the financing, Copper Giant signed a ten-year offtake agreement with Trafigura, one of the world's largest commodity trading houses, covering 20% of the copper concentrate and 20% of the molybdenum concentrate produced from the Mocoa Project in Putumayo Department, southern Colombia, from the commencement of commercial production. Mocoa is one of the largest undeveloped copper-molybdenum porphyry deposits in Latin America, with a resource base of approximately 636 million tonnes at 0.44% copper and 0.025% molybdenum — making it a genuinely world-class asset at a jurisdictional discount that a copper market at record prices and a tariff-driven reshaping of global supply chains is actively repricing. Denarius brings Colombian operational experience from its Zara gold-silver mine in Chocó and silver-copper expertise from its Lomero project in Spain; Trafigura's offtake commitment provides the commodity credibility and downstream marketing certainty that junior copper developers in Latin America have historically found difficult to secure independently. For retail copper investors, the combination of a strategic cornerstone investor with in-country experience plus a blue-chip global trader offtake is the dual validation signal that separates credible advanced development projects from the speculative end of the copper discovery pipeline.

headline: NEWMONT CLOSES 8.2% STAKE IN AWALÉ RESOURCES — $20.7M STRATEGIC FINANCING COMPLETE; $35M CASH FOR ODIENNÉ GOLD-Cu, CÔTE D'IVOIRE (ARIC)
snippet: Awalé Resources Ltd. (TSXV: ARIC) completed a $20.7 million strategic financing on August 6, 2026 with the closing of the final tranche of a non-brokered private placement that includes Newmont Ventures Limited holding approximately 8.2% of the company, Fortuna Mining Corp. holding approximately 13%, and Predictive Discovery holding approximately 12%. The completion leaves Awalé with over $35 million in cash — a funded position sufficient for multiple drill programmes at its 100%-owned properties in Côte d'Ivoire, while Newmont separately continues to fund the Odienné Joint Venture exploration under a separate earn-in agreement. Recent drilling at the Odienné project's BBM target returned results showing the high-grade gold-copper core extends below the open-pit resource model, indicating an underground component not yet captured in current resource estimates — the kind of discovery that triggers re-rating events because it converts a project modelled as heap-leach or open-pit into one with a higher-grade underground mining scenario overlapping existing surface resources. The shareholder register of three major strategic investors — the world's largest gold producer, a $2+ billion mid-tier gold miner, and a well-credentialed Australian West Africa explorer — is an unusual degree of institutional validation for a TSXV junior. The Birimian greenstone belt of Côte d'Ivoire has produced several world-class gold deposits over the past decade, and Odienné's combination of funded exploration, major-producer backing, and emerging underground geometry places it among the most compelling early-stage West African gold stories currently on the TSXV.

headline: OROCO RESOURCE: 26.5m AT 1.18% CuEq EXTENDS SANTO TOMÁS SOUTH ZONE PAST INFERRED BLOCK MODEL — PHASE 2 CERTAINTY DRILLING ADVANCES (OCO)
snippet: Oroco Resource Corp. (TSX-V: OCO, OTC: ORRCF) reported August 6, 2026 the third set of assay results from its Phase 2 resource-certainty drilling program at the South Zone of its Santo Tomás copper porphyry project in Sinaloa, Mexico. Highlight drill hole returned 26.48 metres at 1.18% copper equivalent from the western boundary of the South Zone, with holes S031 and S034 collectively confirming that economically mineralised material extends west of the current inferred block model limits — a structural expansion of the deposit footprint beyond what was modelled in the August 2024 Technical Report. Oroco drills the South Zone with three rigs, targeting confirmation of a near-surface, low-strip-ratio resource that the company has described as one of the most capital-efficient potential development scenarios of any undeveloped copper porphyry in North America, based on the combination of shallow mineralization, straightforward open-pit geometry, and existing road infrastructure. Santo Tomás hosts an August 2024 resource totalling approximately 2.7 billion pounds of indicated copper equivalent across the South and North Zones combined. With copper at $14,000+ per tonne and a US tariff structure confirmed at 15% (2027) and 30% (2028) on imported copper, the value of a near-surface low-strip open-pittable copper resource in Mexico — a CUSMA partner jurisdiction — has increased materially since the resource was last estimated. Each westward extension of the South Zone that exceeds the current block model is an addition to a resource base that will eventually be re-estimated at the new model geometry.
